_comment: Committed, non-secret watcher config for the brain (AI OS primary operator, 2026-11-10). deploy.sh renders each key into the Worker vars; an OS_BRAIN_<NAME> in the environment or ~/.ebda-os.local.env overrides it. CF_ACCOUNT_ID comes from OS_CF_ACCOUNT_ID. Deliberately NOT set: SERVICE_TARGETS (prod-watch probes the same URLs from outside Cloudflare and reports into the brain, ruling OBS-1), DEPLOY_DRIFT_TARGETS (every Ebda deploy workflow is path-filtered, so 'live commit != main tip' is normal; ruling AIOS-3), SENTRY_* (needs a Sentry token Ahmad has not issued).
